scope: Timing-only cache levels and capacity after the requested two rounds; no cache specifications or PMU measurements consulted.

capacity_estimates.evidence: 64 B random: 32 KiB round-2 repeat medians 3.2500–3.2578; coarse median 3.3398. At 36 KiB the median is 8.8242 TSC ticks/load.
64 B random: 256 KiB round-2 repeat medians 8.9414–8.9453; coarse median 8.9336. At 288 KiB the median is 14.5547 TSC ticks/load.
64 B random: 7 MiB median 28.4648; 8 MiB 114.1016 (round 2) / 114.5898 (round 1). Compact 8 B layout: 7 MiB 28.8867; 8 MiB repeats 55.7617 / 57.3242 TSC ticks/load.
capacity_estimates.interpretation: Effective transition in the sampled 7–8 MiB region on a shared machine. Not a bound on nominal physical LLC capacity.

caveats: Another benchmark was observed on CPU 0 before both rounds; potential shared-machine effects were not isolated.
Round 1 and round 2 recorded 276 and 205 involuntary context switches, respectively; all samples retained.
LLC miss-region latency depends on layout and page policy, and some compact-layout time blocks vary.
Intervals are empirical sampling brackets, not statistical confidence intervals or vendor specifications.
third_round: Not run. The two-round request is complete; a narrower bracket or quieter-machine confirmation would require additional measurements.
